other_conditions: Father is not alive or is incapacitated/bedridden due to physical or mental disability
Guardian/family annual income must not exceed ₹35,000 (excluding MNREGA income)
Orphan or neglected girls/women, including inmates of Nari Niketan or former inmates of Balika Ashrams, with no regular source of income
Deserted or divorced women whose income does not exceed ₹35,000 per annum
Girls/women in moral danger or rescued from trafficking
Destitute women or girls released after imprisonment
Daughters of divorced or deserted women with family income not exceeding ₹35,000 per annum
benefits_summary: A marriage grant of ₹40,000 for eligible girls/women (₹51,000 for inmates of Nari Sewa Sadan/Nari Niketan) is provided to cover marriage expenses.
